name: Iceberg Field
desc: An open polar sea scattered with tabular icebergs — flat-topped white bergs with vertical cliff faces and a blue waterline shadow stand in four ranks that drift across each other at their own rates through banks of fog, brash ice and growlers riding out on the current between them, and a cold swell working the dark water below; flat grey overcast, glowing blue hour, a low midnight sun, a cyan sonar chart, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — lit berg faces, water sheen, swell contrast

scale.doc: how large the bergs are — berg width and height (rebuilds the field)

density.doc: how many bergs per rank, brash ice, swell lines and glints

speed.doc: berg drift, fog scroll and swell rate

pack.doc: how much loose brash ice and growlers ride on the water

haze.doc: how thick the fog is — how far back the ranks fade

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default cold polar blue

x.doc: which way the light rakes — which face of each berg is lit

y.doc: the sea horizon — low y gives more sky, high y more water

style.doc: aesthetic: overcast = flat grey polar light, white bergs, slate sea; bluehour = twilight where the bergs glow; midsun = low midnight sun grazing amber berg tops; sonar = cyan sonar/chart returns and berg outlines, no photo shading; ink = sumi silhouettes and tonal wash

act.doc: multi-minute programme — a steady current, a breakup shedding more brash over sections, or the water skinning over with more fog and calmer drift

seed.doc: regenerates the berg shapes, placement, brash and fog

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
